title: Kansas bans student phones, earbuds and smartwatches for entire school day

Schools are now reviewing technology policies and limiting device usage during non-instructional periods.

India's own fifth-generation fighter is also expected to fly around 2028. This collaboration aligns with India-France's strategic defense partnership goals. The joint effort aims to advance both nations' aerial combat capabilities.

Following a confession during the confrontation, the accused has been apprehended, and inquiries continue to ascertain the precise details and motives surrounding this case.

The proposal is currently under federal review and public comment.

This adjustment acknowledges the global supply chain challenges affecting material availability, which may lead to homebuyers experiencing possession delays of up to four months for their properties.

She reiterated the DMK's consistent position on delimitation and called for constitutional changes to uphold the representation of southern states. Additionally, the DMK urged the government to resolve the ongoing Mekedatu dam and Cauvery water disputes.

Living independently and suffering from schizophrenia, she had lost touch with her family for nearly two years. The police notified her brother, who confirmed her identity. An unnatural death report is now underway, prompting further investigative actions.

This latest controversy intensifies the scrutiny on Infantino's leadership at FIFA, particularly following the controversial withdrawal of a World Cup investment proposal.

Despite reporting impressive revenue growth, the surge in expenses, particularly from severance and legal fees, negatively influenced the second quarter's operating income. The company is committed to advancing its AI infrastructure to pave the way for future innovations and anticipates a reduced headcount due to the layoffs.

All injured individuals were taken to a hospital for necessary medical treatment.  Six of the injured were later referred to a larger hospital for further care.  Rescue teams were dispatched to the accident site for immediate assistance.

The Congress party sees opportunities in upcoming state elections next March.

The court will consider laying down must-treat guidelines for medical institutions. Police will also be mandated to video record statements of sexual assault complainants. This action follows the tragic death of a minor girl after being denied timely medical care.

title: Dostoevsky, Tehran coup novels found in Atiq Ahmed's son's car

While his vehicle was found to contain personal belongings, including books by Fyodor Dostoevsky and Marjan Kamali, police clarified that these items were unrelated to the circumstances of the crash. The severe injuries Aaban suffered ultimately led to his untimely passing, while his associate Sonu remains in critical condition following the collision.

The collaboration introduces the first standardized game-day jewelry as part of the squad's look and includes a fan collection inspired by Texas pride. The launch also highlights the growing influence of the cheerleaders beyond football, blending fashion, tradition and modern team branding.
